title: AI-designed brain-penetrant HER2 inhibitor IAM1363 shows durable responses in Phase 1/1b
summary: Iambic reported updated Phase 1/1b data for IAM1363, a selective brain-penetrant HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor, at ESMO 2026. Among 122 participants across Parts 1-4 (data cutoff 31 August 2026), the company reported low rates of Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events, durable responses, and intracranial responses in patients previously treated with T-DXd and tucatinib. More than half of participants dosed at 960 mg remained on study.

evidence.tested: IAM1363 was given to 122 participants in a Phase 1/1b trial, with tolerability, response and intracranial response data reported.
evidence.unknown: Company press release of a conference poster; efficacy numbers are company-reported, not peer reviewed; the stated AI contribution to the molecule is general and not detailed.
evidence.ai_role: The molecule was 'designed using Iambic's molecular superintelligence platform' and progressed to clinic in about two years, as stated by the company.
